_comment: Ethereum mainnet (1) currencies to wire into ChainlinkPriceOracle via SetOracleFeeds.s.sol. Parallel arrays; `symbol` keys into script/oracle_feeds.json, `decimals` is the token's own ERC-20 decimals (18 for native ETH = address(0)). Every address below was verified on-chain (symbol + decimals) on 2026-09-08. Two entries may share one `symbol` — native ETH and WETH both price off ETH/USD. Feeds present in oracle_feeds.json but not wired: SOL and AVAX have no canonical ERC-20 on mainnet. WBTC rides BTC/USD because oracle_feeds.json carries no mainnet WBTC/USD entry; cbBTC has its own. POL's feed is still named MATIC / USD on-chain (the token was renamed, the feed was not). Wrapped/bridged representations ride the base asset's feed: a depeg of the wrapper itself is outside what the oracle can see. That is the same trade-off already taken for WBTC on chains with no WBTC/USD feed.
